name: Tri Cities Fall 2022
information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TriCitiesFall2022#22544-competitor-responsibilities) tab. For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out the [PNW website](https://www.pnwcubing.com)! Please be aware of Covid-19 precautions and read [this tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SpokaneFall2022#22042-covid-19-safety) before registering.
